title: Behind Time
description: Emma has disappeared, leaving behind questions that refuse to stay unanswered. As the search for the truth unfolds, hidden details begin to surface, and every discovery brings new questions. What really happened to Emma? And how much of the truth has been left behind?
features: Choice-Based Gameplay: Your decisions shape the story.
Immersive Mystery: Solve puzzles and uncover secrets.
Chat-Based Storytelling:  Experience the story through interactive messages.
how_to_play:
1- Read & Respond: Experience the story through interactive chat messages.
2- Make Choices: Your decisions shape the story and lead to different outcomes.
3- Uncover Clues: Find hidden details, solve puzzles, and piece together the mystery.
4- Interact with Characters: Talk to various characters and discover their secrets.
